### Additional helper functions
```{r}

# Clean risk factors
clean_risk_factors <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      N_Biop = factor(N_Biop),
      N_Rels = factor(N_Rels),
      AgeMen = na_if(AgeMen, 99),
      Age1st = na_if(Age1st, 98),
      Race = factor(Race),
      bodysizebminow = na_if(bodysizebminow, 999)
    )
}

# Test for significant association
assoc_tests <- function(df, y, preds, time_adjust = TRUE, multivariable = FALSE) {
  if(!multivariable) {
    map_dfr(preds, ~{
      predictor_name <- .x
      formula_str <- if (time_adjust) {
        paste('qlogis(',y,')', "~", predictor_name, "+ time_start_to_mammo")
      } else {
        paste('qlogis(',y,')', "~", predictor_name)
      }
      
      lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = df %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(predictor_name)))) %>%
        tidy() %>%
        filter(startsWith(term, predictor_name)) %>%
        select(statistic = estimate, p.value) %>%
        mutate(
          variable = predictor_name,
          test = "lm",
          .before = 1
        )
    })
  } else {
    
  }
}

# Plotting MIRAI vs predictors
plot_y_vs_all <- function(
    df,
    y = "mirai_score_5y",
    predictors = c(
      "T1", "N_Biop", "AgeMen", "Age1st", "N_Rels",
      "cumulus_reading"
    ),
    time_adjust = F
) {
  df_clean <- clean_risk_factors(df)
  
  if ("pregparitycnt" %in% predictors) {
    predictors[predictors == "pregparitycnt"] <- "pregparity_binary"
  }
  preds <- intersect(predictors, names(df_clean))
  tests <- assoc_tests(df_clean, y, preds, time_adjust = time_adjust)
  list(plot = NULL, tests = tests)
}

# Harrels C-index calculation
ci_calc <- function(data, risk_scores, N = 5000) {
  c_indices <- list()
  
  for(score in risk_scores) {
    concordance_index <- with(data |> filter(!is.na(!!sym(score))) |> mutate(score = !!sym(score)), Cindex(risk = score, times = time.ci, delta = case_control_status))
    
    # Bootstrapping for C-Index
    # If no N given, simply output the concordance index
    if(!is.na(N)){
      
      ci_sample <- numeric(0)
      for(i in 1:N){
        ci_sample[i] <- with(data |> filter(!is.na(!!sym(score))) |> mutate(score = !!sym(score)) |> sample_n(size = n(), replace = T), Cindex(risk = score, times = time.ci, delta = case_control_status))
      }
      
      ci_lower <- unname(quantile(ci_sample, probs = 0.025))
      ci_upper <- unname(quantile(ci_sample, probs = 0.975))
      
      c_indices[[score]] <- data.frame(cindex = concordance_index, lower = ci_lower, upper = ci_upper)
      
    } else {
      
      c_indices[[score]] <- concordance_index
      
    }
    
  }
  
  return(c_indices)
}


# Five fold cross validation of c index cox regression
ff_cox_bootstrap <- function(formula, data, N = 5000){
  
  
  base_ci <- five_fold_ci(formula, data)
  
  ci_bt <- numeric(0)
  for(i in 1:N){
    
    bootstrapped_data <- data[sample(1:nrow(data), size = nrow(data), replace = T),]
    ci_bt[i] <- five_fold_ci(formula, data)
    
  }
  
  return(base_ci)
  
}

five_fold_ci <- function(formula, data){
  
  set.seed(123)
  data.folds <- vfold_cv(data, v = 5)
  
  # Loop through folds fitting the model and calculating a c index
  c_indices <- numeric(0)
  for(i in 1:5){
    
    # Fit cox model
    cox.model <- coxph(formula = as.formula(formula), data = analysis(data.folds$splits[[i]]))
    
    # Plot residuals if i = 1
    if(i == 1){
      # print(qqnorm(y = cox.model$residuals))
    }
    
    # Fit risk scores on the validation set
    risk.scores <- predict(cox.model, newdata = assessment(data.folds$splits[[i]]), type = "risk")
    
    validation.set <- assessment(data.folds$splits[[i]]) |>
      mutate(risk.score = risk.scores)
    
    c_indices[i] <- ci_calc(data = validation.set, risk_scores = "risk.score", N = NA)
  
  }
  
  # Average the c index
  c_index <- mean(unlist(c_indices))
  
  return(c_index)
  
}
```

### Table 2
Correlations of the MIRAI score with variables included in the GAIL model as well as mammographic density
```{r}

# Get data relevant for Table 2
study.data <- scores_and_rf_data$output %>%
  select('TCode', 'case_control_status', 'cumulus_reading', 'mirai_score_5y', 'gail_score',
         'bodysizebminow') %>%
  left_join(scores_and_rf_data$gail_data, by='TCode')

# Univariable association test
correlation <- plot_y_vs_all(study.data %>% filter(case_control_status == 0), time_adjust = F)

# Clean risk factors and conduct multivariable test
study.data.cleaned <- clean_risk_factors(study.data %>% filter(case_control_status == 0))
preds <- c(
  "T1", "N_Biop", "AgeMen", "Age1st", "N_Rels",
  "cumulus_reading"
)
study.data.cleaned <- study.data.cleaned |>
  mutate(across(all_of(preds),
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 1, 0),
                .names = "{.col}_NA")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(preds), ~ {
      if (is.factor(.)) {
        addNA(.)
      } else {
        replace(., is.na(.), 0)
      }
    })
  )

non_factor_preds <- preds[!sapply(study.data.cleaned[preds], is.factor)]
na_cols <- paste0(non_factor_preds, "_NA")
all_preds <- c(preds, na_cols)
formula_str <- paste(all_preds, collapse = "+")
correlation_mv <- summary(lm(as.formula(paste('qlogis(mirai_score_5y)', "~", formula_str)), data=study.data.cleaned))
correlation_mv <- as.data.frame(correlation_mv$coefficients)
correlation_mv$variable <- rownames(correlation_mv)
rownames(correlation_mv) <- NULL
correlation_mv <- correlation_mv |>
  mutate(
    
    variable = case_when(
      variable == "N_Biop1" ~ "N_Biop",
      variable == "N_Rels1" ~ "N_Rels",
      TRUE ~ variable
    )
    
  )

# Create table 2
table2 <- as.data.frame(correlation$tests) |>
  merge(correlation_mv, by = "variable") |>
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = c("T1", "N_Biop", "AgeMen", "Age1st", "N_Rels", "cumulus_reading"), labels = c("Age at mammogram (years)", "No. benign breast biopsies","Age at menarche (years)", "Age at first pregnancy (years)", "No. 1st-degree relatives with breast cancer", "Mammographic density"))) |>
  arrange(variable) |>
  select(variable, p_value_1 = p.value, p_value_2 = `Pr(>|t|)`) |>
  mutate(across(starts_with("p_value"), function(x){
    case_when(
      x < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f",x)
    )
  })) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    variable ~ md("**Risk Factor**"),
    p_value_1 ~ md("**P Value\n(Univariable)**"),
    p_value_2 ~ md("**P Value\n(Multivariable)**")
  )

table2

gtsave(table2, "../../results/tables/table_2.docx")


```


### Table 3
Harrel's C-index calculated for four risk scores both in the whole study population (when possible) and the subset of the study population that contains mammographic density measured
```{r}

#############
# Execution #
#############

study.data <- scores_and_rf_data |> 
  mutate(gail_eligible = study.exit.age <= 90 & study.entry.age >= 20,
         cumulus_eligible = !is.na(cumulus_reading))
# All are Gail eligible (per >= 90yrs and <= 20 yrs criteria)

# No filter: Mirai
cindex_compldata <- ci_calc(study.data, c("gail_score", "mirai_score_5y"), N = 10)

# Only non-missing Cumulus reading eligible: Cumulus and Mirai
cindex_denssubsetdata <- ci_calc(study.data %>% filter(cumulus_eligible), c("gail_score", "cumulus_reading", "mirai_score_5y"), N = 10)
table(cumulus_available=study.data$cumulus_eligible)
prop.table(table(cumulus_available=study.data$cumulus_eligible))

## Table Generation

# Initialise dataframe
table3 <- data.frame(risk_score = character(0), c_index = character(0), c_index_sub = character(0))

for(score in names(cindex_denssubsetdata)){
  
  # Get subset C-index and CI
  ci_sub <- cindex_denssubsetdata[[score]]
  ci_sub <- paste0(sprintf("%.3f",ci_sub$cindex), " (", sprintf("%.3f",ci_sub$lower), ", ",sprintf("%.3f",ci_sub$upper), ")")
  
  # If it is in complete then grab that if not just output "-"
  if(score %in% names(cindex_compldata)){
    
    ci <- cindex_compldata[[score]]
    ci <- paste0(sprintf("%.3f",ci$cindex), " (", sprintf("%.3f",ci$lower), ", ", sprintf("%.3f",ci$upper), ")")
    
  } else {
    
    ci <- "-"
    
  }
  
  table3[nrow(table3) + 1,] <- c(score, ci, ci_sub)
  
}

# Table formatting
table3_gt <- table3 |>
  filter(risk_score != "iCARE_Lit_risk_5") |>
  mutate(risk_score = factor(risk_score, levels = c("gail_score", "mirai_score_5y", "cumulus_reading"), labels = c("GAIL", "Mirai", "Cumulus"))) |>
  arrange(risk_score) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    risk_score = md("**Risk Score**"),
    c_index = md("**C-Index (95% CI)**"),
    c_index_sub = md("**C-Index (95% CI)\n(Subset)**")
  )

table3_gt
  
# Save to docx
gtsave(table3_gt, "../../results/tables/table_3.docx")
```

```{r}
for(comb in risk_score_combinations){

  # Write formula for cox regression
  formula <- paste0("Surv(time = pmin(study.exit.age - study.entry.age, time.of.onset), event = case_control_status) ~ ", paste0(paste0(comb), collapse = " + "))

  # # Write formula for cox regression
  # formula <- paste0("Surv(time = study.entry.age, time2 = pmin(study.exit.age, study.entry.age + time.of.onset), event = case_control_status) ~ ", paste0(paste0(comb), collapse = " + "))
  
  # If formula contains density, add eliglble tag
  if("cumulus_reading" %in% comb){
    formula <- paste0(formula, "+ cumulus_eligible")
  }
  
  # Define data to fit cox model on
  cox.data <- study.data |>
    mutate(gail_score = gail_score/100) |>
    mutate(cumulus_reading = cumulus_reading/100) |>
    mutate(across(all_of(all_risk_scores), function(x){
      qlogis(x)
    })) |>
    mutate(across(all_of(all_risk_scores), function(x){
      x/sd(x, na.rm = T)
    })) |>
    mutate(cumulus_reading = na.replace(cumulus_reading, 0.5))
  
  cox.model <- coxph(formula = as.formula(formula), data = cox.data)
  
  print(comb)
  
  cox.data <- cox.data |>
    mutate(score = cox.model$linear.predictors)
  
  ci <- ci_calc(cox.data, risk_scores = "score", N = NA)
  print(ci)
  
  # Add to univariable column if necessary
  if(length(comb) == 1){
    
    hazard_ratio <- summary(cox.model)$conf.int |>
      as.data.frame() |>
      filter(row_number() != n() | !"cumulus_reading" %in% comb) |>
      mutate(risk.score = comb) |>
      mutate(univ = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", `exp(coef)`), " (", sprintf("%.3f",`lower .95`), ", ", sprintf("%.3f", `upper .95`), ")")) |>
      pull(univ)
    
    if(!"univ" %in% names(table4)){
      table4$univ <- NA
    }
    
    table4 <- table4 |>
      mutate(
        univ = if_else(risk.score == comb, hazard_ratio, univ)
      )
    
  } else {
    
    # Iterate through columns
    col <- col + 1
    
    hazard_ratio <- summary(cox.model)$conf.int |>
      as.data.frame() |>
      filter(row_number() != n() | !"cumulus_reading" %in% comb) |>
      mutate(risk.score = comb) |>
      mutate(!!sym(paste0("mv_", col)) := paste0(sprintf("%.3f", `exp(coef)`), " (", sprintf("%.3f",`lower .95`), ", ", sprintf("%.3f", `upper .95`), ")")) |>
      select(risk.score, paste0("mv_", col))
    
    table4 <- table4 |>
      merge(hazard_ratio, by = "risk.score", all.x = T)
    
  }
  
  
}


# Formatting the table
table4_gt <- table4 |>
  mutate(
    
    risk.score = case_when(
      risk.score == "gail_score" ~ "GAIL",
      risk.score == "mirai_score_5y"~ "Mirai",
      risk.score == "cumulus_reading" ~ "Cumulus"
    )
    
  ) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), function(x){
    na.replace(x, "-")
  })) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_spanner(
    label = md("**HR (95% CI)\n(Univariable)**"),
    columns = univ
  ) |>
  tab_spanner(
    label = md("**HR (95% CI)\nMultivariable**"),
    columns = all_of(starts_with("mv_"))
  )
  
table4_gt

# Save to docx
gtsave(table4_gt, "../../results/tables/table_4.docx")
```
